name: Aswang
speed_detail: 1.53 m/s base; fast LOS acceleration (8.67s to max)
tells: Accelerates faster on line of sight; hunt ends immediately if it reaches a player inside an official hiding spot.

name: Banshee
tells: Always female; targets one player and ignores others while they are inside; 33% chance to scream on Parabolic Mic; prefers singing events.

name: Dayan
speed_detail: 2.25 m/s moving near (<=10m) / 1.2 m/s still near
tells: Always female; speeds up (2.25 m/s) when a nearby player moves within 10m and slows (1.2 m/s) when still.

name: Deildegast
speed_detail: Starts 3.0 m/s; drops 0.1 m/s per item interaction (min 0.4 m/s)
tells: Starts hunts at 3.0 m/s and slows down as items are interacted with/thrown (down to 0.4 m/s).

name: Demon
tells: 70% hunt threshold and ability can hunt at any sanity; 60s smudge timer instead of 90s; crucifix effective range +50% per tier.

name: Deogen
tells: Always knows player location during hunts (cannot hide); sprints at 3.0 m/s from afar and slows to 0.4 m/s when close; unique heavy breathing on Spirit Box.

name: Gallu
speed_detail: 1.36 m/s Weakened / 1.7 m/s Normal / 1.96 m/s Enraged
tells: Cycles Normal, Enraged (1.96 m/s, ignores salt/crucifix while enraged), and Weakened (1.36 m/s) states based on protective gear.

name: Goryo
tells: Cannot change favorite room (except Monkey Paw wish); D.O.T.S only appears through a video camera when no players are in the ghost room.

name: Hantu
speed_detail: Up to 2.7 m/s in freezing cold / 1.4 m/s in warm rooms
tells: Faster in cold rooms and slower in warm rooms; no LOS speed boost; never turns breaker on; emits freezing breath during hunts when breaker is off.

name: Jinn
speed_detail: 2.5 m/s on LOS (>3m) when Breaker is On
tells: Speeds up to 2.5 m/s in line of sight (>3m) when breaker is on; never turns breaker off directly; can drain 25% sanity near players/breaker.

name: Kormos
tells: Blind visual detection past ~5m; tracks player footsteps; never performs Ghost Mist or chase events.

name: Mare
tells: Never turns lights ON; high chance to immediately turn lights OFF or burst light bulbs; hunts at 60% sanity in dark / 40% in lit room.

name: Moroi
speed_detail: 1.5 m/s at >=45% sanity up to 2.25 m/s at 0% sanity
tells: Moves faster as average sanity drops (plus LOS boost); Spirit Box/Parabolic Mic response curses passive sanity drain; blinded for ~7s by smudge instead of 5s.

name: Myling
tells: Footsteps and vocals are only audible within 12m during hunts (normal is 20m); makes frequent Parabolic Microphone sounds.

name: Obake
tells: Can leave 6-fingered handprints (or 2 on switches / 5 on keyboards); briefly shapeshifts model during hunt blinks; 25% chance to leave no UV.

name: Obambo
speed_detail: Slower when Calm / Faster when Aggressive
tells: Alternates between Calm (slower, 10% hunt threshold) and Aggressive (faster, 65% hunt threshold) states every 2 minutes, even mid-hunt.

name: Oni
tells: More active near players; drains 20% sanity on ghost events instead of 10%; stays visible longer during hunt blinks; never does Ghost Mist events.

name: Onryo
tells: Lit flames/candles act like crucifixes (4m range) and block hunts; blowing out 3 flames triggers a hunt; can extinguish same flame twice in <20s; never lights candles.

name: Phantom
tells: Taking a photo during an event/D.O.T.S makes it disappear and it won't appear in the photo; roams to random players leaving EMF 2; longer invisibility gaps in hunts.

name: Poltergeist
tells: Throws items every 0.5s during hunts and can trigger high-velocity multi-item explosions (draining 2% sanity per thrown item).

name: Raiju
tells: Moves at 2.5 m/s near active player electronics (6m/8m/10m by map size); disrupts electronics from 15m instead of 10m; hunts at 65% sanity near electronics.

name: Revenant
speed_detail: 1.0 m/s no target / 3.0 m/s on target detection
tells: Moves slowly at 1.0 m/s until detecting a player (LOS, voice, or active electronics), surging instantly to 3.0 m/s.

name: Shade
tells: Will not start a hunt or do EMF 3 object throws while a player is in the same room; prefers Ghost Mist events; never sings; hunts at 35% sanity.

name: Spirit
tells: Smudge/incense blocks hunts for 180s instead of the standard 90s.

name: Thaye
tells: Starts fast and very active (75% hunt threshold), aging every 1-2m near players down to 1.0 m/s and 15% threshold; no LOS speed boost.

name: The Mimic
tells: Always shows Ghost Orbs (even on 0-evidence runs) and switches which ghost's abilities, hunt threshold, and speed it copies every 30-120s.

name: The Twins
tells: Can perform a close interaction and a long-range interaction (up to 16m) within 1-2s; hunts alternate between 1.53 m/s and 1.87 m/s.

name: Wraith
tells: NEVER steps in or disturbs salt piles (and ignores Tier 3 salt slowdown); can teleport to a random player outside hunts leaving EMF 2 (or 5).

name: Yokai
tells: Talking near it can trigger hunts up to 80% sanity; short hearing/electronics detection range (~2.5m) during hunts.

name: Yurei
tells: Can fully close an open door (including the front/exit door) with a delayed double door-touch sound; smudge traps it in its room for 90s; ability drains 15% sanity.
